empty.title: Focus mode
empty.body: A quiet room with just your timer and your step. Pick a step from Today to begin.

unknown_step.title: We couldn't find that step
unknown_step.body: It may have been removed or moved. Nothing is lost; pick another step from Today.

already_done.title: That step is already done
already_done.body: Nice. Want to keep the momentum going with the next one?

tools.leave: Leave focus mode (your timer keeps going)

timer.label: Time left
timer.last_step: This is the last step of the quest

keys.hint: Space pauses, Enter twice marks done, Q captures a thought, Esc stops.
keys.enter_again: Press Enter again to mark this step done

switch.title: You're in the middle of “{{current}}”
switch.body: Your timer is still going here. Want to switch to “{{other}}” instead? This one's time is kept.

length.title: Timer length
length.description: Pick a length. The time you've already focused stays.
length.invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 240.

distraction.title: Park that thought
distraction.description: Write it down and it waits in your Inbox. Your timer keeps going.
distraction.label: What popped up?
distraction.placeholder: Reply to Sam, buy oat milk…

stop.title: Stop for now?
stop.body: Your {{time}} of focus is saved. You can pick this step up any time.

ambience.title: Background sounds
ambience.sound_off: Sound is turned off in Settings, so this stays quiet.

pledge.title: Phone away, tabs closed
pledge.body: Take a breath. Your timer starts in a moment.

time_up.title: Time's up. Nice focus!
time_up.away_title: Your timer ended while you were away
time_up.away_body: No problem at all. What would you like to do next?

idle.title: Still on it?
idle.body: Your timer ended a while ago. Whatever happened is fine.

break.title: Take a breather
break.body: Stretch, sip some water, look out of a window.
break.label: Break time left

finish.title: Quest complete!
finish.body: You finished “{{quest}}”. Every step of it.

stopped.title: Saved. Rest is part of it.
stopped.body: You focused {{time}} on “{{step}}”. It's all kept.
stopped.toast: Saved. Come back whenever you're ready.

estimate.note: Just data for next time. Guessing gets easier the more you do it.

companion.studying: Your study owl is reading along

banner.label: Focus session
banner.away: Your timer ended while you were away

notify.nudge_body: “{{step}}” is waiting, and your timer is still going. Tap to come back.
notify.focus_end_body: Done with “{{step}}”, or keep going? Tap to choose.

welcome_back.title: Welcome back
welcome_back.body: Your timer kept going. Pick up right where you were.

history.title: Focus history
history.subtitle: Every session counts, short ones too.
history.empty_body: Your focus sessions will show up here, day by day.

settings.title: Focus
settings.pledge_hint: A 3-second “phone away, tabs closed” moment before the timer. You can skip it.
settings.nudge: Nudge me when I leave the app
settings.nudge_hint: A gentle sound and notification while a timer runs. Time away is never held against you.
settings.idle_hint: Asked when a timer ended a while ago and nothing has happened since.
settings.notifications_granted: On. Nudges can reach you outside the app.
settings.notifications_denied: Blocked in your browser settings. Sound nudges still work.
settings.notifications_unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Sound nudges still work.
